subject: [PATCH 02/60] mm: publish and clear node memory states via helpers

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series introduces a new way to manage node memory states by centralizing updates in two new helpers. The author believes this will make it easier to handle different types of memory and improve the code's maintainability.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series centralizes the updates of node memory states by introducing two new helpers, `node_set_memory_state` and `node_clear_memory_state`. These functions are used to publish and clear the N_MEMORY state, which is currently set in various places throughout the code. The goal is to make it easier to manage node memory states and allow for more flexibility in handling different types of memory.
